Name: Lavril - NPC Adventures
Author: Arknir27
Description:
[left]This is a content pack that adds the East Scarp Custom NPC, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10016]Lavril[/url]﻿, to NPC Adventures. This mod is useless on its own. Make sure to have the aforementioned mod and all its dependencies installed.[/left]
[center]﻿﻿﻿[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/257895149517013002/952810577967874078/Lavril_void_walk.gif[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]Lavril is now compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4582]PurrplingCat 's NPC Adventures mod[/url]﻿! You can recruit her as a healer, but she occasionally runs away from danger. She has 50+ additional dialogue in unique locations, adding more immersion in the game.
[*]3 unique idle animations when following you and staying still.
[*]Access to her inventory (36 extra slots). If you leave your items with Lavril overnight, Void mails them to you on the next day in a colorful way.
[/list][color=#444444]..
.
[center][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/257895149517013002/952813428261675008/cc_box.png[/img]﻿[/center][/color]
[center]﻿[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/266144973613826048/952811599721267220/Hat_Shop.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]Recruit Lavril and Void at the same time with PeacefulEnd's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8626]Custom Companions[/url]﻿. Void can be recruited at the Mouse Hat shop for 30,000g. Summon him with the ring and he will accompany you and Lavril on your adventures.
[/list][color=#444444].
.[/color][color=#444444]
.[/color][center][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/257895149517013002/952815240700100628/cc_box2.png[/img][/center][center][color=#444444]﻿
[/color][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/266144973613826048/952811829627871242/Pain_Begone.gif[/img] [/center]﻿[color=#444444].[/color]
UNIQUE companion skills:[list]
[*][Limited Healing] - Talk to Lavril when your health is low to get healed. Heals a few times before needing to recharge.
[*]Activate a [Soul Link] with the player. Lavril and Void cheer you on with their spectral energy, boosting your stats by +3 ATK, +1 LUCK, and 1+ SPEED.
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
Lavril becomes a companion!
[list=1]
[*]Install NPC Adventures & Lavril - East Scarp NPC.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
